Julia —

Thanks for the heads up. We can support a 48-hour short-window top-up aligned to your campaign, with two options (quick summary below). I'll attach a short terms doc after this email.

Option A (Temporary uplift, pay-as-you-go):
- Provision additional quota to hit the peak QPS (22) for the 48-hour window.
- Billing: pro-rata of the monthly commit rate for the uplifted capacity + per-token usage for any tokens beyond uplift.
- Overrun handling: daily overrun measured and invoiced the following month; we apply a 5% goodwill credit on overrun charges for first-time spikes.

Option B (Burst buffer credit):
- We allocate a transient burst credit bucket (one-time purchase) sized to your estimate.
- Billing: one-time fee, no ongoing pro-rata change; if bucket used up, we revert to per-token overrun pricing.

I'll send the temp_topup_terms.pdf with exact numbers and a short pricing_calc.csv to illustrate the pro-rata math. From a policy perspective we recommend Option A for predictable routing and automatic KV caching behavior.

If that's acceptable I can spin up the uplift and follow up with a confirmation email that includes the exact QPS cap and the billing notes.

—Marcus
